note: v3 adopts the acts kernel for the five structural events: outline_item_added/removed/moved/reordered/hidden become concise schema-validated Acts under {type, version, payload}. Payloads contain only structure (item, parent/rank-derived slot, and changed state); actor, outliner/space, timestamp, and verb stay in the committed log envelope, while note prose stays on the $outline_item artifact. No stored object state changes shape, so steps is empty; the manifest update delivers the verbs, $outline_meta, and @local:acts dependency. Consumers accept both the pre-v3 flat observation shape and the v3 Act shape during rolling upgrades. Cross-outliner movement is refused until routed multi-space Acts exist, and lifecycle hooks no longer write structure. Raw substrate recycle remains an explicitly out-of-band destructive repair path whose handler performs defensive edge cleanup without emitting an Act.
